title: The Meeting
hook: Konya, 1244. A wandering stranger met the city's most respected scholar.

segments.en: I was an ascetic; you made me a singer of songs.
I was a dignified man of the prayer rug.
You made me a plaything for the children of the street.

tafsir: Old biographers tell the story of that first meeting in different ways.
In one, Shams stops Rumi in the street with a single hard question.
Whatever happened that day, they all agree: Rumi was never the same.
The serious scholar on his prayer rug became a poet who sang.
And listen to his tone. He is not complaining. He is smiling at himself.
Sometimes one meeting turns a whole life into a song.

outro.say: Part four. Why did Rumi's students turn against Shams? Follow The Guest House.
